odd_C3_C5.meaning: Every active base carrier has response rank zero and a live direct pair. A no-cap arc can reach it only through response-pivot rank drop; fixed-rank rowspace incidence cannot persist.

phase_K4_K4.meaning: Every active base carrier has response rank zero and a live direct pair. A no-cap arc can reach it only through response-pivot rank drop; fixed-rank rowspace incidence cannot persist.

fractional_matching_scope.cap_guard: Odd-set data are support-only, while carrier activity is a coefficient/rank condition and is not closed at rank drop. No source-labelled implication from every Tutte obstruction to a clean-cap/descent antecedent follows.
fractional_matching_scope.leakage_formula: diagonal_degree_i,c=d_c-L_i,c, where L_i,c is the total offdiagonal endpoint-colour energy. Moment zero does not make L_i,c site-independent, so it need not give a diagonal fractional one-factor.
fractional_matching_scope.leakage_free: If diagonal colour-c port degrees all equal d_c>0, then x_ij=|A_ij^(c,c)|^2/d_c is a fractional one-factor. Its half-integral extreme points are unit matching edges and half-weight odd cycles. Absence of an integral perfect matching gives a Tutte odd-set obstruction.

diagonal.fractional_one_factor: edge weight 1/2 on both odd cycles

offdiagonal_leakage.graph: C3 disjoint_union C5, all six a!=b cells per edge

phase_adjusted_column_star_order3_termin.verdict: The adjusted full column-star specialization kills all 24 U-X rows but has twelve literal mixed U-V/response rows at order three.

canonical_cross_quartic_test.verdict: vanishing of every order-two mixed coefficient forces the order-four pure coefficient to vanish

phase_base_jacobian_and_cross_jet.linear_image: outputs differing from colour zero only at the endpoints of one edge in the phase-cancelling left K4
phase_base_jacobian_and_cross_jet.reason_linear: pure colours 1 and 2 are outside this 33-dimensional image
phase_base_jacobian_and_cross_jet.scope: This excludes the first normal cone and the cheapest four-cross-edge GHZ jet. Delayed internal/cross corrections at higher filtration order are not classified.

phase_binary_m6_hafR_zero_resolution.global_m6_conclusion: The k4 term is zero independently of Haf(R), and E4 gives H6=-Haf(L)Haf(R). Hence the entire product-zero complement (including Haf(L)=0,Haf(R)!=0) has H6=0. The six-branch theorem excludes the product-nonzero open. Therefore every binary leading pure coefficient at total order m=6 is impossible at the phase K4 disjoint-union K4 base. Binary word closure makes this stable under arbitrary third-colour coupling.
phase_binary_m6_hafR_zero_resolution.k2_contraction: The six literal E4 rows are L_I Haf(R)+sum_J R_(J^c)P[I,J]=0. On Haf(R)=0 they give sum_J R_(J^c)P[I,J]=0 for every I. Multiplying by L_(I^c) and summing I is exactly the full k2 degree-six contribution, so k2=0 for arbitrary R support. More generally k2=-2 Haf(L)Haf(R), since sum_I L_I L_(I^c)=2Haf(L).
phase_binary_m6_hafR_zero_resolution.k4_laplace: The 36 degree-two rows give per_2(X[I,J])=0, hence X is a row star, column star, or one 2x2 cancellation block. For a row star choose two left rows avoiding its centre; for a 2x2 block choose the complementary two rows; for a column star choose two right columns avoiding its centre. In the corresponding fixed Laplace expansion of per_4(tX+t^2V), the chosen 2x2 factor has zero degree-three polar P (indeed X is zero there), while every degree-two complementary factor is per_2(X)=0. Therefore its degree-six coefficient is zero.

minimum_support_orbits.first_coefficient_cancellation: The minimum support carrying nonzero matching products but Haf(R)=0 is the union of two right perfect matchings (a C4), one S4 orbit, with m1+m2=0.
minimum_support_orbits.k2_R_single_edge: A single R edge is the minimum k2 support and is one S4 orbit; Haf(R)=0 automatically.
minimum_support_orbits.k4_R_empty: R has empty support; there is one orbit and only the direct four-cross term can contribute.

phase_binary_m6_hafR_zero_resolution.pure_degree6_decomposition: H6=Haf(L)Haf(R) + sum_(I,J)L_(I^c)R_(J^c)P[I,J] + [t^6]per_4(tX+t^2V), where I,J run over left/right pairs.
phase_binary_m6_hafR_zero_resolution.verdict: On Haf(R)=0 all three summands of H6 vanish. Thus no binary pure6 jet exists on this divisor, for any R support and every direct-X support orbit. Literal equations close the branch before carrier pivot or blocker valuations and before adding the second colour.

phase_binary_m6_partition_ledger.exhaustive_reduction: Every binary total-pure-order-six topology is impossible or reduces to U@1,X@1,R@1,L@2,V@2. There is no third integer partition.

ledger.1113_k0: Impossible: two left-internal pure edges are needed but only one edge has valuation >1; an order-one left-internal (c,c) cell has an uncancellable linear word.
ledger.1113_k2: Impossible: the left-internal edge must have valuation 3 and the two cross edges valuation 1. Their order-two per_2 word is lower than the pure term and contains its cross factor.
ledger.1113_k4: Impossible: per_2(X)=0 puts the order-one cross support in a star or one 2x2 cancellation block, so it has no size-three matching required by the 1+1+1+3 pure term.
ledger.1122_k0: Both left edges have valuation 2 and both right edges valuation 1. Cancelling the left linear rows forces the oriented U@1 response system; without a direct polar E4 kills it, and with a direct polar it is the classified coupled channel.
ledger.1122_k2: If the cross valuations are 1,1 and R has valuation 2, the order-two per_2(X) row kills the pure factor. The only remaining assignment is L@2,R@1,X@1,V@2, exactly the coupled channel.
ledger.1122_k4: The degree-six per_4 coefficient is a Laplace sum of degree-two per_2(X) and degree-three P_(X,V) factors. Without L@2,R@1 it vanishes; with them it reduces to the same coupled channel.

phase_binary_m6_partition_ledger.minimum_R_support_resolution: For R_45 R_67!=0 with no extra R edges, row-star and 2x2-X are excluded. A column-star with at least three nonzero X entries first obeys the 24 omitted U-X equations, forcing sum_(j!=4)U_ij=0. E2/E3 then force U_4=-b/3, U_6+U_7=-b, L=(1/3)B(b,b), and B(X,V)=-L. The next six U-V rows force B(V,b)=0, contradicting B(X,V)=-L when Haf(L)!=0.

next_support_orbits.meaning: Beyond the two-entry column-star on the minimum-R orbit, any remaining m6 binary escape lies in one of the five denser-R orbits (one extra edge; two adjacent; two opposite; three; four).

phase_binary_m6_partition_ledger.smallest_unresolved_minimum_R_branch: Column-star X with exactly two nonzero row entries. One entry is the already excluded row-star; three or four entries are killed by the U-X/U-V polar chain above.

branches.four_extra: All b,c,d are proportional to y, and E3 makes their scalars equal. Thus q67=q57=q56; E4 gives h*q67=0. With h!=0 this again forces the no-extra contradiction.
branches.no_extra: m45!=0 and E4 gives q67=0. Then P45=-R45 L. The rows B(x,b)=0 make b=mu*(x0,-x1,0,0); comparing B(x,V5) with R45 B(a,b) on rows 02 and 12 gives V5_2=+R45 mu a2 and V5_2=-R45 mu a2. Likewise at site3, so Haf(L)=0.
branches.one_extra: No second right matching product is completed, so E4 still gives q67=0 and the no-extra contradiction is unchanged.
branches.three_extra: Exactly one additional matching product is completed. The same proportionality/equality gives q67=q56, so E4 is h*q67=0 and reduces to the no-extra contradiction.
branches.two_adjacent: No complementary extra pair is present; again h=m45 and the no-extra contradiction applies.
branches.two_opposite: A second matching is completed. The two XUR rows make its two U columns proportional to y; E3 equality makes the scalars equal. Hence q67=q57, and E4 becomes h*q67=0. Since h!=0, q67=0 and the no-extra comparison kills Haf(L).

literal_rows.E3_nonincident: R67(q45+L)=R57(q46+L)=R56(q47+L)=0. Thus every live nonincident R edge identifies the corresponding B(a,U_j) with -L.
literal_rows.E4_contraction: m45 q67 + m46 q57 + m47 q56=0. The L terms cancel exactly after substituting the three incident E3 polar rows.
literal_rows.order2_UX: B(x,b+c+d)=0. For a two-entry x on rows 0,1, every U column selected by a live complementary R edge is supported on rows 0,1 and is proportional to y=(x0,-x1,0,0).
literal_rows.order3_XUR: R67 B(x,b)=0, R57 B(x,c)=0, R56 B(x,d)=0. These are the literal words with colour c on a left pair and on the three right sites consisting of 4 plus the chosen R edge.

phase_binary_m6_six_branch_resolution.localization: Binary coupled channel with Haf(L)Haf(R)!=0, a live right matching normalized to 45|67, and X a two-entry column star on column 4. This is exactly the six-branch antichain left by the partition/support ledger.
phase_binary_m6_six_branch_resolution.notation: Write a,b,c,d for U columns 4,5,6,7, x for the two-entry X column, and B(u,v)_ik=u_i v_k+u_k v_i. Let m45=R45 R67, m46=R46 R57, m47=R47 R56 and h=m45+m46+m47=Haf(R).
phase_binary_m6_six_branch_resolution.scope_guard: This exhausts the frozen six-branch response-component antichain. A divisor with Haf(R)=0 but a nonzero direct k=2/k=4 pure6 polar is not represented by this antichain and must not be claimed closed.
phase_binary_m6_six_branch_resolution.verdict: All six support branches are empty on Haf(L)Haf(R)!=0. Since the contradictions are binary literal rows, a second physical colour cannot cancel them; all carrier pivot and four-way blocker branches are excluded upstream.

phase_cancellation_control.meaning: This balanced diagonal base point has no leakage and many integral perfect matchings. Its vanishing is phase cancellation, invisible to fractional-matching and odd-cut support data.

phase_column_star_order6_survivor.equation_check: E2, E3, and E4 vanish identically; Haf(L)Haf(R)=12 and the full literal pure coefficient [t^6]H_11111111=-12
phase_column_star_order6_survivor.general_family: For z_0 z_1 z_2 z_3!=0 set U_i4=U_i5=U_i6=z_i, U_i7=0, X_i4=z_i, V_i5=z_i, R_45=R_67=1, L_ij=-2 z_i z_j. Then Haf(L)Haf(R)=12 product_i z_i and the full pure coefficient is -12 product_i z_i.

literal_omitted_order2_obstruction.cokernel_guard: Every word has three colour-c sites including right site 4, whereas im(dH at the phase base) has right block colour zero. No order-two source correction can cancel it.
literal_omitted_order2_obstruction.contradiction: All six left complementary base cells are nonzero Q(w) units. The pure coefficient requires product_i z_i!=0, so all six displayed order-two mixed coefficients are nonzero.

phase_column_star_order6_survivor.terminal_scope: The family survives only the reduced E2--E4 packet and pivot nonvanishing. The six literal omitted rows kill it before any blocker-membership choice.

phase_delayed_order6_seed.failure: 12 mixed words survive at order 3 and 7 at order 4. Hence this is an exact lifted second-order seed, not an admissible GHZ jet.

finite_coefficient_system.exact_exclusion: A nonzero order-six pure coefficient requires Haf(L)Haf(R)!=0. Then Haf(R)!=0, while the six order-four cokernel rows force every L_I=0, a contradiction. Thus this entire valuation channel has no admissible GHZ-leading m=6 seed.
finite_coefficient_system.order2_elimination: 3 L_I + sum_(|J|=2) per_2(U[I,J])=0 for all six left pairs I
finite_coefficient_system.order3: R_J*(per_2(U[I,J^c]) + L_I)=0; the matching support R_45,R_67 gives the displayed 12 rows
finite_coefficient_system.order4_six_rows: L_I*Haf(R)=0 for all six left pairs I

phase_delayed_order6_seed.induced_correction: L_I=-(1/3) sum_(|J|=2) r_(J^c) per_2(U[I,J]); for U all-one and the unit right base this is L_I=-4
phase_delayed_order6_seed.scope: This is the oriented binary response channel U^(c,0)@1, R_right^(c,c)@1, L_left^(c,c)@2.  The contradiction is not an all-valuations or arbitrary-multichannel m=6 theorem.

phase_minimal_order.order4: Impossible. Pure colours 1 and 2 require four order-one cells. An internal-left (c,c) cell has a unique forbidden linear word, leaving the all-cross route; its order-two per_2 shell kills per_4.
phase_minimal_order.order5: Impossible. A 1+1+1+2 matching either contains an order-one internal-left (c,c) cell, or its k=2/k=4 contribution contains an order-one cross pair already killed by the quadratic mixed shell.
phase_minimal_order.order6_mechanism: Order-one cross (c,0) cells can quadratically induce order-two left-internal (c,c) corrections, while order-one right-internal (c,c) cells supply a candidate Haf(L)Haf(R) pure coefficient.
phase_minimal_order.scope: The m=4 and m=5 exclusions hold independently in each binary {0,c} channel and therefore survive arbitrary third-colour coupling. The response-only m=6 exclusion is channel-specific.

phase_next_coupled_order6_channel.binary_word_closure: Every displayed output word uses only colours {0,c}; cells using the third physical colour cannot cancel these coefficients.
phase_next_coupled_order6_channel.first_escape_from_previous_obstruction: The new polar term sum_J R_(J^c)P_(X,V)[I,J] has exactly the same left-pair/right-four word as L_I Haf(R), so the six E4 rows no longer force L=0.  This is the first finite channel not excluded by the previous response-only argument.
phase_next_coupled_order6_channel.polar_definition: P_(X,V)[I,J] is the coefficient of t^3 in per_2(t X[I,J]+t^2 V[I,J]).
phase_next_coupled_order6_channel.status: First unresolved finite system.  Order-4/5 cokernel rows and the 72 positive no-cap pivot valuations must be appended before any positive Puiseux seed is admissible.
phase_next_coupled_order6_channel.support_reduction: The 36 equations per_2(X[I,J])=0 imply that the nonzero support of X is a row star, a column star, or is contained in one 2x2 block with its single permanent cancellation.  Thus the literal right-site S4 symmetry reduces the first-order direct support to these three types; the phased left K4 has trivial exact site stabilizer.

column_star_X.representative: column 4, with the z-family frozen separately

phase_order6_support_type_resolution.right_symmetry: The minimum Haf(R)!=0 support is one right perfect matching; right S4 has one orbit, represented by R_45=R_67=1.

row_star_X.proof: If the X-star row is r, then P_(X,V)[I,J]=0 whenever the left pair I avoids r. E4 and Haf(R)!=0 force L_I=0 for all three such pairs. Every left perfect matching contains one pair avoiding r, hence Haf(L)=0.

phase_order6_support_type_resolution.smallest_surviving_branch: column-star X with two-edge R matching

two_by_two_X.proof: Put the X block on rows {0,1}, columns {4,5}. E4 gives L_23=0. With R_45 R_67!=0, E3 gives q_45=-L and q_67=0, while E2 gives B(a+b,c+d)=2B(a,b), where a,b,c,d are the four columns of U and q_45=B(a,b). The symmetrized-product lemma forces q_01 q_23=q_02 q_13=q_03 q_12. Since q_23=0, Haf(q_45)=0, so Haf(L)=0.
two_by_two_X.scope_guard: Denser R support in the 2x2-X stratum is not classified; it cannot beat the column-star survivor's two-edge R support.
two_by_two_X.symmetrized_product_lemma: If B(a+b,e)=2B(a,b) in characteristic zero, the three complementary products of the six off-diagonal entries of B(a,b) are equal. This follows after writing a=(s+d)/2, b=(s-d)/2: solvability of r_i+r_j=1-delta_i delta_j forces at least three delta_i equal; degenerate coordinate cases follow by the same cross-multiplied identities.

phase_order_independent_contraction_and_.finite_remainder: Order seven reduces to eight primitive binary signatures: four from 1123 and four from 1222. The 1114 partition is empty. Third physical colour cannot cancel any binary output row.
phase_order_independent_contraction_and_.formal_series: Let L_I(t), R_J(t), C_ij(t) be the binary (c,c) left, right, and cross cells. The literal word with colour c on left pair I and on all four right sites has series E_I=L_I Haf(R)+sum_J R_(J^c) per_2(C[I,J]).

m7_1114.k0: Two left-internal edges are required but only one valuation exceeds one, so an uncancellable order-one left linear word occurs.
m7_1114.k2: The only assignment avoiding left valuation one is L4,R1,C1,C1; the lower per_2(X) shell kills its cross factor.
m7_1114.k4: A 1114 cross matching needs three disjoint order-one X edges, impossible in the per_2(X)=0 star/2x2 support types.

m7_1123.immediate_eliminations: Every signature with L1 is killed by the unique left linear word; every k2 signature with C1,C1 is killed by per_2(X).

m7_1222.immediate_eliminations: Every signature with L1 is killed.

phase_order_independent_contraction_and_.m7_partition_guard: There are three, not two, weak positive partitions of seven into four edge valuations: 1114, 1123, and 1222. The last cannot be omitted without an additional source lemma.
phase_order_independent_contraction_and_.order_independent_contraction: On the mixed-word ideal E_I=0, multiplication by L_(I^c) and summation over all six I gives k2=-2 Haf(L)Haf(R) coefficientwise. Thus at every valuation the pure series reduces to H_pure=per_4(C)-Haf(L)Haf(R).
phase_order_independent_contraction_and_.why_not_yet_general: The four-coloured-site rows which would separately control the 2x2 cross permanents are contaminated by oriented (c,0)/(0,c) response products. No source-faithful identity currently equates per_4(C) with Haf(L)Haf(R) at arbitrary valuation.

second_order_blind_direction.meaning: dH and the second fundamental form both vanish on X0. A second-variation-only properness proof cannot exclude all balanced-base tangent directions; cubic/higher jets are necessary.

status: PASS exact odd-set scope and Luna second-variation obstruction
terminal_verdict: Edmonds/Tutte reduces only the leakage-free no-perfect-matching support branch. Cross-colour energy leakage and exact complex cancellation are independent balanced base mechanisms. At the smallest odd base, the Luna quadratic form has genuine cokernel obstructions but also an explicit direction invisible through second order. Therefore neither graph support nor second variation alone proves mixed-norm properness; a carrier-stratified cubic/higher GHZ-accessibility theorem is still required.
